questions.explanation_english: Augmented reality enhances educational environments by superimposing computer-generated 3D graphics, text, or interactive animations onto a user’s real-world physical surroundings in real time. This overlay capability allows students to interact with complex digital instructional objects, spatial diagrams, and contextual data directly within their immediate physical learning environment.
